confirmed.description: Whether the defect survived the attempt to kill it.

strongest_counterargument.description: REQUIRED EVEN WHEN CONFIRMED. A falsifier that agrees without stating the best case against the finding has not falsified anything, and 'I could not think of one' is an answer this field can carry -- an empty one is not.

reasoning.description: How the counterargument was tested, and why it did or did not hold.

remaining_uncertainty.description: What is still unknown. NO minItems, deliberately: a falsifier with nothing left to doubt is a real answer, and requiring an entry here would force invented content -- or produce nothing valid at all from a model that declines to invent.

severity_adjustment.description: A revised severity, if the attempt to kill the finding changed what it is worth. Null means unchanged.
